blocks.text: Yeh chapter 7 (Reaction Kinetics) ke poore chapter se practice long questions (tafseeli sawal) hain, Board ke long question ki shakal mein: har sawal 4 number ka hai (wazahat, equations, zaroorat ho to diagram), aur chapter ke numericals qadam ba qadam hal kiye gaye hain. Har sawal ka poora model jawab hai.

blocks.prompt:
1 State the collision theory of reaction rates. Explain effective collisions, activation energy and the activated complex. (4 marks)
(Reaction rates ki collision theory bayan karein. Effective collisions, activation energy aur activated complex ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Collision theory: reaction hone ke liye reactants ke particles (atoms, ions ya molecules) homogeneous mixture bana kar aapas mein takrayein.

Effective aur ineffective collisions: takkarein particles ki energy ke lihaaz se effective ya ineffective hoti hain. Effective takkar se products bante hain; warna particles wapas uchhal jaate hain. Effective takkar sirf tab hoti hai jab particles ke paas khaas energy ho aur woh durust rukh (proper orientation) se milein.

Activation energy: reacting species ki effective takkar ke liye darkaar kam se kam energy. Aksar reactions aahista hain, yani saari takkarein barabar effective nahi.

Activated complex: potential energy aur reaction ke raaste ke graph par reactants curve ki choti par activated complex banate hain. Sirf activation energy wale molecules yeh pahari chadh kar products dete hain; effective takkar ke baad alag hone wale molecules kimiyaai taur par mukhtalif hote hain, warna wohi molecules wapas uchhal jaate hain.

book_ref.quote: Collision theory explains how reactions occur.

blocks.prompt:
2 Define rate of reaction and give its units. For A → B, write the rate in terms of A and B, and explain the concentration-time graph. (4 marks)
(Rate of reaction ki definition aur units likhein. A → B ke liye rate A aur B ki surat mein likhein aur concentration-time graph ki wazahat karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Definition: reactant ya product ki concentration ki tabdeeli ko us mein lage waqt se taqseem karna rate of reaction hai.
Rate = Δx/Δt; Δx bohat chhote waqfe Δt mein concentration ki chhoti tabdeeli hai.

Units: concentration/waqt = mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹; aahista reactions ke liye mol dm⁻³ min⁻¹ ya mol dm⁻³ h⁻¹; gas phase mein pressure ki units.

A → B ke liye: Rate = −Δ[A]/Δt = +Δ[B]/Δt. Manfi nishan batata hai ke A ki concentration kam ho rahi hai; B ki concentration barhti hai is liye musbat nishan.

Graph (Figure 7.1): [A] girta aur [B] barhta hai. Shuru mein slopes sab se zyada (tez tabdeeli). Phir slopes kam hoti hain, reaction aahista hota hai aur rate har lamhe badalta hai. Aakhir mein dono curves parallel ho jaate hain; yeh reaction mukammal hone ki stage hai.

book_ref.quote: The rate of a reaction is defined as the change in the concentration of a reactant or a product divided by the time taken for the change.

blocks.prompt:
3 In N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) → 2NH₃(g), the concentration of NH₃ rises from 0.80 mol dm⁻³ at 2.0 min to 2.0 mol dm⁻³ at 6.0 min. Calculate (i) the average rate of formation of NH₃ in mol dm⁻³ min⁻¹ and in mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹ (ii) the average rate of consumption of N₂ in this interval. (4 marks)
(N₂(g) + 3H₂(g) → 2NH₃(g) mein NH₃ ki concentration 2.0 min par 0.80 se 6.0 min par 2.0 mol dm⁻³ ho jati hai. (i) NH₃ banne ka average rate mol dm⁻³ min⁻¹ aur mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹ mein (ii) is waqfe mein N₂ ke istemal ka average rate nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Average rate = ΔC/Δt; 1 mol N₂ se 2 mol NH₃, is liye N₂ aadhe rate se istemal hota hai.

book_ref.quote: If the concentration of ammonia is 3.5 mol dm⁻³ after 1.0 min and 6.2 mol dm⁻³ after 4.0 minutes?

steps: NH₃ banne ka rate = 1.2/4.0 = 0.30 mol dm⁻³ min⁻¹
N₂ ke istemal ka rate = ½ × 0.30 = 0.15 mol dm⁻³ min⁻¹
blocks.final_answer: (i) 0.30 mol dm⁻³ min⁻¹ = 5.0 × 10⁻³ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹ (ii) 0.15 mol dm⁻³ min⁻¹

blocks.prompt:
4 Define instantaneous and average rate. Explain how the rate of decomposition of HI at a given time is found from a concentration-time graph. (4 marks)
(Instantaneous aur average rate ki definition likhein. HI ki decomposition ka kisi waqt par rate concentration-time graph se kaise nikala jata hai, wazeh karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Instantaneous rate: waqfe ke kisi aik lamhe ka rate.
Average rate: do khaas auqaat ke darmiyan, yani aik waqfe ka rate. Dono sirf aik lamhe ke liye barabar hote hain; shuru mein instantaneous zyada aur aakhir mein kam hota hai.

Naapna: reactant ya product ki concentration baqaida waqfon par maloom ki jati hai (2HI → H₂ + I₂ ke liye Table 7.1). x-axis par waqt aur y-axis par [HI] le kar graph banaya jata hai. HI reactant hai, is liye curve girta hai. Curve ki dhalwan reaction ki pesh-raft batati hai; shuru mein slope jitni zyada, rate utna zyada.

Tangent method: maslan 100 s par rate ke liye curve par 100 s par tangent banayein aur tangent ko hypotenuse bana kar right-angled triangle ABC mukammal karein. Rate = ΔC/Δt = tangent ki slope, yani us nuqte ka instantaneous rate.

Product (H₂ ya I₂) ka graph barhta hua curve hai; do mole HI se aik aik mole H₂ aur I₂ banta hai, is liye us ka tangent HI ke tangent se aadha dhalwan wala hota hai.

book_ref.quote: To determine the rate of reaction for a given length of time, a graph is plotted between time on x-axis and concentration of a reactant on y-axis, whereby a curve is obtained.

blocks.prompt:
5 Using Table 7.1 for 2HI(g) → H₂(g) + I₂(g) ([HI] = 0.100, 0.0716, 0.0558 and 0.0457 mol dm⁻³ at 0, 50, 100 and 150 s), calculate the average rate of disappearance of HI in each 50 s interval and the average rate of formation of H₂ in the first 50 s. What do the results show? (4 marks)
(Table 7.1 (0, 50, 100, 150 s par [HI] = 0.100, 0.0716, 0.0558, 0.0457 mol dm⁻³) se har 50 s waqfe mein HI ke khatam hone ka average rate aur pehle 50 s mein H₂ banne ka average rate nikalein. Nataij kya batate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Har waqfe ke liye average rate = −Δ[HI]/Δt; H₂ aadhe rate se banta hai kyunke 2 mol HI se 1 mol H₂.

book_ref.quote: Table 7.1 Change in concentration of HI with regular intervals, 2HI(g) → H₂(g) + I₂(g)

steps: Har waqfe mein rate kam hota hai: HI khatam hone ke saath reaction aahista hota hai.
blocks.final_answer: HI: 5.68 × 10⁻⁴, 3.16 × 10⁻⁴, 2.02 × 10⁻⁴ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹; H₂ (0-50 s): 2.84 × 10⁻⁴ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹; rate waqt ke saath kam hota hai.

blocks.prompt:
6 Describe the chemical method of measuring the change in concentration during the acid hydrolysis of ethyl acetate. (4 marks)
(Ethyl acetate ki acid hydrolysis ke dauran concentration ki tabdeeli naapne ka chemical method bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Chemical method khaas taur par solution ke reactions ke liye munasib hai; reactant ya product ka kimiyaai tajziya kiya jata hai.

Reaction: CH₃COOC₂H₅(l) + H₂O(l) → CH₃COOH(l) + C₂H₅OH(l), H⁺ (thora sa acid) catalyst.

Tareeqa:
1. Ester ka paani mein solution aur acid catalyst react karne diye jaate hain.
2. Kuch der baad pipette se mixture ka sample nikal kar apne volume ke taqreeban chaar guna barf jaise thande paani mein daala jata hai. Dilution aur thandak reaction rok dete hain.
3. Banne wala acid standard alkali (NaOH) ke khilaaf phenolphthalein indicator se titrate kiya jata hai.
4. Yeh tajziya reaction shuru hone ke baad mukhtalif waqfon par dohraya jata hai.

Nateeja: mukhtalif auqaat par banne wale acetic acid ki concentration ki tabdeeli milti hai, jis se rate maloom hota hai.

book_ref.quote: In case of hydrolysis of an ester, the solution of ester in water and the acid acting as a catalyst are allowed to react.

blocks.prompt:
7 Describe the physical methods used to follow the change in concentration during a reaction. (4 marks)
(Reaction ke dauran concentration ki tabdeeli dekhne ke physical methods bayan karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Reactants ya products ki concentration ki tabdeeli physical tareeqon se bhi dekhi jati hai.

(i) Spectrophotometry ya colorimetry: jab reactant ya product ultraviolet, visible ya infrared radiation jazb kare. Jazb hone wali radiation ki miqdaar se rate naapa jata hai (maslan Figure 7.3 ka rangeen reaction).

(ii) Electrical conductivity method: ions wale reactions ke liye. Reacting ions ke khatam hone ya naye ions banne se solution ki conductivity badalti hai, jo un ions ki concentration ki tabdeeli batati hai.

(iii) Volume change method: jin reactions mein gases ka volume badle; nikalne wali gas jama kar ke waqt ke saath us ka volume naapa jata hai (Figure 7.4). Volume ki tabdeeli reaction ki pesh-raft aur concentration ki tabdeeli ke barah-e-raast mutanasib hai.

Bohat tez reactions: stopped-flow spectrophotometry. Reactants ki thori miqdaar tezi se mixing chamber aur phir observation cell mein jaati hai jahan (aam taur par UV transmission se) pesh-raft dekhi jati hai; rate-time graph khud ban jata hai.

book_ref.quote: Some of the methods used for the measurement of concentration are as follows:

blocks.prompt:
8 What is the Boltzmann distribution curve? Use it to explain why increasing the temperature increases the rate of a reaction. (4 marks)
(Boltzmann distribution curve kya hai? Is ki madad se wazeh karein ke temperature barhane se rate kyun barhta hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Mushahida: temperature barhane se rate barhta hai; har 10 °C par rate do ya teen guna ho jata hai.

Boltzmann distribution: kisi temperature par molecular energies ki taqseem ka graph (molecules ki tadaad vs energy). Kuch particles ki energy bohat kam, kuch ki bohat zyada aur zyada tar ki darmiyani hoti hai. Curve ke neeche ka area particles ki tadaad hai. Eₐ se aage shaded area un particles ki tadaad hai jin ki energy Eₐ se zyada hai, yani jo takkar par react kar sakte hain.

Temperature ka asar (Figure 7.7):
1. Temperature barhne se particles ki average kinetic (harkat ki) energy barhti hai.
2. Particles tez chalte hain, takkarein zyada aur zyada energy wali hoti hain.
3. Zyada temperature ka curve chapta ho jata hai aur peak daayen khisak jati hai.
4. 10 °C barhne par Eₐ se aage shaded area taqreeban do guna, yani kaamyaab takkarein bohat barh jaati hain.
Is liye temperature barhane se rate barhta hai.

book_ref.quote: The distribution of energies at a given temperature can be shown on a graph as shown in Figure 7.6, this is called the Boltzmann distribution.

blocks.prompt:
9 Define catalyst and catalysis. Explain how a catalyst increases the rate of a reaction, giving three examples with equations. (4 marks)
(Catalyst aur catalysis ki definition likhein. Catalyst reaction ka rate kaise barhata hai, teen misalein equations ke saath de kar wazeh karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Catalyst: woh shay jo chemical reaction ka rate badle magar reaction ke aakhir mein kimiyaai taur par wohi rahe. Aksar bohat thori miqdaar mein hota hai.
Catalysis: catalyst ki maujoodgi mein hone wala amal.

Kaise kaam karta hai: catalyst kam activation energy wala naya raasta deta hai (Figure 7.8). Ab zyada molecules nayi energy rukawat paar kar lete hain, is liye rate barhta hai.

Misalein:
1. H₂ aur O₂ aam temperature par bohat aahista, platinum ke saath tez: 2H₂ + O₂ → 2H₂O (Pt)
2. Thori si MnO₂ se KClO₃ tez decompose hota hai: 2KClO₃ → 2KCl + 3O₂ (MnO₂)
3. CuCl₂ ki maujoodgi mein HCl ka Cl₂ mein oxidation: 4HCl + O₂ → 2H₂O + 2Cl₂ (CuCl₂)

book_ref.quote: A catalyst provides a new reaction path with a low activation energy barrier

blocks.prompt:
10 Explain homogeneous and heterogeneous catalysis with two examples of each. Add a note on enzymes. (4 marks)
(Homogeneous aur heterogeneous catalysis ko do do misalon ke saath wazeh karein. Enzymes par note bhi likhein.)
blocks.explanation:
Homogeneous catalysis: catalyst aur reactants aik hi phase mein; system har jagah homogeneous aur catalyst yaksaan phaila hota hai.
1. NO(g) catalyst ke saath 2SO₂(g) + O₂(g) → 2SO₃(g); reactants aur catalyst sab gases.
2. H₂SO₄ (H⁺) ke saath esters ki hydrolysis: CH₃COOCH₂CH₃(l) + H₂O(l) → CH₃COOH(l) + CH₃CH₂OH(l); sab solution mein.

Heterogeneous catalysis: catalyst aur reactants mukhtalif phases mein; aksar catalyst solid aur reactants gas ya liquid.
1. Platinum gauze par ammonia ka oxidation (HNO₃ banane ke liye): 4NH₃(g) + 5O₂(g) → 4NO(g) + 6H₂O(g) (Pt, 800 °C)
2. Bareek Ni, Pd ya Pt par hydrogenation: C₂H₄(g) + H₂(g) → C₂H₆(g) (Ni, 150 °C)

Enzymes: biochemical catalysts (qudrat ke catalysts), aam taur par proteins, jo jaandaaron mein activation energy kam kar ke rate barhate hain. In ki activity pH, temperature aur substrate ki concentration par munhasir hai.

book_ref.quote: In such systems, the catalyst and the reactants are in different phases.

rows: Catalyst aur reactants aik phase mein.
Catalyst aur reactants mukhtalif phases mein.
Catalyst aksar solid; reactants gas ya liquid.
NO ke saath SO₂ + O₂; H₂SO₄ ke saath ester hydrolysis.
Pt par NH₃ oxidation; Ni, Pd ya Pt par hydrogenation.

blocks.prompt:
11 What is a rate law? Write the rate equation for a general reaction, define the specific rate constant and show what it represents. (4 marks)
(Rate law kya hai? Aam reaction ka rate equation likhein, specific rate constant ki definition dein aur dikhayein ke yeh kya zahir karta hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Rate law: rate ko reactants ki concentrations ki surat mein bayan karna; woh equation jo rate ko concentrations se jorti hai jin ki powers tajurbe se milti hain.

aA + bB → cC + dD ke liye:
Rate = k[A]ˣ[B]ʸ
x aur y tajurbati hain, a aur b ke barabar ho bhi sakte hain aur nahi bhi. [ ] molar concentrations hain aur k rate constant hai.

Specific rate constant: jab reactants ki concentrations ikaai hon to reaction ka rate.
[A] = 1 aur [B] = 1 mol dm⁻³ par: Rate = k × 1ˣ × 1ʸ = k

Diye gaye halaat mein k sabit rehta hai (concentration se nahi badalta), magar temperature se badalta hai. Yeh kisi khaas reaction ke liye khaas temperature par makhsoos hai.

book_ref.quote: A rate law is an equation that relates the rate of a reaction to the concentrations of reactants raised to various powers according to the experimental data.

blocks.prompt:
12 For 2NO(g) + O₂(g) → 2NO₂(g), Rate = k[NO]²[O₂]. At a certain temperature the rate is 2.8 × 10⁻⁵ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹ when [NO] = 0.010 mol dm⁻³ and [O₂] = 0.020 mol dm⁻³. Calculate (i) the value and unit of k (ii) the rate when [NO] is doubled at the same [O₂]. (4 marks)
(2NO(g) + O₂(g) → 2NO₂(g) ke liye Rate = k[NO]²[O₂]. Kisi temperature par [NO] = 0.010 aur [O₂] = 0.020 mol dm⁻³ par rate 2.8 × 10⁻⁵ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹ hai. (i) k ki qeemat aur unit (ii) usi [O₂] par [NO] do guna karne par rate nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Rate equation ko k ke liye rearrange karein; overall order 3 se unit milegi. [NO] do guna karne se rate 2² guna.

book_ref.quote: The brackets [ ] represent the molar concentrations

steps: k = 14; overall order 3, is liye unit dm⁶ mol⁻² s⁻¹
blocks.final_answer: (i) k = 14 dm⁶ mol⁻² s⁻¹ (ii) rate = 1.1 × 10⁻⁴ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹ (chaar guna)

blocks.prompt:
13 Define order of reaction. Explain third order and fractional order reactions with examples, and show why order cannot be found from the balanced equation. (4 marks)
(Order of reaction ki definition likhein. Third order aur fractional order reactions ko misalon ke saath wazeh karein, aur dikhayein ke order balanced equation se kyun nahi milta.)
blocks.explanation:
Order: kisi reactant ka order rate equation mein us ki concentration ka exponent hai; overall order tamam exponents ka majmua (Rate = k[A]ˣ[B]ʸ mein x + y). Yeh tajurbe se maloom hota hai.

Third order reaction: exponents ka majmua teen.
Rate = k[A]³, ya k[A]²[B], ya k[A][B][C]
Misaal: 2FeCl₃(aq) + 6KI(aq) → 2FeI₂(aq) + 6KCl(aq) + I₂, Rate = k[FeCl₃][KI]². Is mein aath reactant molecules hain magar tajurbe se third order hai.
Aur: 2NO(g) + O₂(g) → 2NO₂(g), Rate = k[NO]²[O₂].

Fractional order reaction: exponents ka majmua kasr (fraction).
Misaal: CHCl₃(l) + Cl₂(g) → CCl₄(l) + HCl(g), Rate = k[CHCl₃][Cl₂]^(1/2), n = 1.5. Free radicals wale reactions aksar fractional order dikhate hain.

Equation se nahi: FeCl₃/KI mein coefficients ka majmua 8 magar order 3; 2N₂O₅ → 2N₂O₄ + O₂ mein coefficient 2 magar Rate = k[N₂O₅] (first order). Exponents coefficients ke barabar hon zaroori nahi.

book_ref.quote: A third order reaction is the reaction for which sum of the exponents of the concentrations in the rate equation is three.

blocks.prompt:
14 Derive a general expression for the units of the rate constant and use it to find the units of k for zero, first, second and third order reactions. (4 marks)
(Rate constant ki units ka aam formula hasil karein aur us se zero, first, second aur third order reactions ke k ki units nikalein.)
blocks.explanation:
Concentrations mol dm⁻³ mein aur rate mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹ mein. Rate = k[Reactants]ⁿ (n = order) se:
k = Rate/[Reactants]ⁿ = (mol dm⁻³) s⁻¹ / (mol dm⁻³)ⁿ
k = (mol dm⁻³)¹⁻ⁿ s⁻¹

Zero order (n = 0): k = mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹
First order (n = 1): k = s⁻¹
Second order (n = 2): k = dm³ mol⁻¹ s⁻¹
Third order (n = 3): k = dm⁶ mol⁻² s⁻¹

Yani k ki units order aur waqt ki unit par munhasir hain.

book_ref.quote: The units for k depend on the order of the reaction and the units of time.

blocks.prompt:
15 For a reaction A + B → products, the following initial rates were measured: experiment 1, [A] = 0.10, [B] = 0.10 mol dm⁻³, rate = 2.0 × 10⁻⁴ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹; experiment 2, [A] = 0.20, [B] = 0.10, rate = 8.0 × 10⁻⁴; experiment 3, [A] = 0.10, [B] = 0.20, rate = 4.0 × 10⁻⁴. Find the rate law, the value and unit of k, and the rate when [A] = 0.30 and [B] = 0.050 mol dm⁻³. (4 marks)
(Reaction A + B → products ke initial rates: experiment 1, [A] = 0.10, [B] = 0.10 mol dm⁻³, rate = 2.0 × 10⁻⁴ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹; experiment 2, [A] = 0.20, [B] = 0.10, rate = 8.0 × 10⁻⁴; experiment 3, [A] = 0.10, [B] = 0.20, rate = 4.0 × 10⁻⁴. Rate law, k ki qeemat aur unit, aur [A] = 0.30, [B] = 0.050 mol dm⁻³ par rate nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Aik waqt mein aik concentration badlein: rate ka factor = (concentration ka factor)^order. Phir experiment 1 se k nikalein.

book_ref.quote: Table 7.2 shows the rates of reaction obtained using various initial concentrations of each reactant.

steps: Expt 1 → 2: [A] do guna, rate 4 guna (2²), A mein order 2
Expt 1 → 3: [B] do guna, rate 2 guna (2¹), B mein order 1
Rate law: Rate = k[A]²[B] (overall third order)
blocks.final_answer: Rate = k[A]²[B]; k = 0.20 dm⁶ mol⁻² s⁻¹; rate = 9.0 × 10⁻⁴ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹

blocks.title: Wazahat
blocks.text: Har dafa sirf aik concentration badli gayi hai, baaqi sabit. Is liye rate ki tabdeeli sirf usi reactant ki wajah se hai. 2 guna concentration par 4 guna rate = 2², yani order 2.

blocks.prompt:
16 For H₂O₂(aq) + 2I⁻(aq) + 2H⁺(aq) → 2H₂O(l) + I₂(aq), rate = k[H₂O₂][I⁻]. Using experiment 1 of Table 7.2 ([H₂O₂] = 0.0200, [I⁻] = 0.0100 mol dm⁻³, rate = 3.50 × 10⁻⁶ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹), find k. Then calculate the initial rate when [H₂O₂] = 0.0250 mol dm⁻³ and [I⁻] = 0.0150 mol dm⁻³. What is the effect of doubling [H⁺]? (4 marks)
(H₂O₂ + 2I⁻ + 2H⁺ → 2H₂O + I₂ ke liye rate = k[H₂O₂][I⁻]. Table 7.2 ke experiment 1 ([H₂O₂] = 0.0200, [I⁻] = 0.0100 mol dm⁻³, rate = 3.50 × 10⁻⁶) se k nikalein. Phir [H₂O₂] = 0.0250 aur [I⁻] = 0.0150 mol dm⁻³ par initial rate nikalein. [H⁺] do guna karne ka kya asar hoga?)
blocks.explanation: Rate ko dono concentrations ke hasil-e-zarb se taqseem kar ke k; phir naye concentrations par wohi k; H⁺ zero order hai.

book_ref.quote: Step 2 Rearrange the equation in terms of k

steps: [H⁺] rate equation mein nahi (zero order), is liye do guna karne se rate nahi badlega
blocks.final_answer: k = 1.75 × 10⁻² dm³ mol⁻¹ s⁻¹; rate = 6.6 × 10⁻⁶ mol dm⁻³ s⁻¹; [H⁺] do guna karne ka koi asar nahi

blocks.prompt:
17 A sample of hydrogen peroxide decomposes by a first-order reaction with a half-life of 2.5 hours. Calculate (i) the rate constant in s⁻¹ (ii) the time taken for its concentration to fall from 0.60 mol dm⁻³ to 0.15 mol dm⁻³. (4 marks)
(Hydrogen peroxide ka aik sample first-order reaction se decompose hota hai, half-life 2.5 ghante. (i) rate constant s⁻¹ mein (ii) concentration 0.60 se 0.15 mol dm⁻³ hone ka waqt nikalein.)
blocks.explanation: Half-life ko seconds mein badal kar k = 0.693/t₁/₂; ginein ke 0.60 se 0.15 tak kitni dafa aadha hota hai.

book_ref.quote: A sample of hydrogen peroxide has a half-life of 2 hours.

blocks.prompt:
18 The first-order isomerisation of a compound has a half-life of 25.0 min. Calculate its rate constant in s⁻¹ and in min⁻¹, and state why its unit is not dm³ mol⁻¹ s⁻¹. (4 marks)
(Aik compound ki first-order isomerisation ki half-life 25.0 min hai. Rate constant s⁻¹ aur min⁻¹ mein nikalein, aur batayein ke is ki unit dm³ mol⁻¹ s⁻¹ kyun nahi.)
blocks.explanation: k = 0.693/t₁/₂, t₁/₂ ko matlooba unit mein rakh kar; first-order k ki unit 1/waqt hai.

book_ref.quote: Step 1 convert minutes to seconds

steps: 0.693 ki unit nahi, is liye k ki unit 1/waqt; dm³ mol⁻¹ s⁻¹ second-order k ki unit hai
blocks.final_answer: k = 4.62 × 10⁻⁴ s⁻¹ = 2.77 × 10⁻² min⁻¹; unit 1/waqt kyunke reaction first order hai

blocks.prompt:
19 What is a reaction mechanism? Define elementary reaction and molecularity, and explain unimolecular, bimolecular and termolecular steps with examples. (4 marks)
(Reaction mechanism kya hai? Elementary reaction aur molecularity ki definitions dein, aur unimolecular, bimolecular aur termolecular steps ko misalon ke saath wazeh karein.)
blocks.explanation:
Reaction mechanism: molecular satah par reaction ke products banane ki qadam ba qadam tafseel. Overall equation sirf reactants aur products dikhati hai, mechanism alag alag elementary steps dikhata hai.

Elementary reaction: bohat se reactions kai qadmon mein hote hain; har qadam elementary reaction hai jo atoms, ions ya molecules ki takkar se hota hai aur aik molecular waqia (bonds ka tootna ya banna) hai.

Molecularity: elementary step mein shamil reactant molecules ki tadaad.
1. Unimolecular: sirf aik reactant molecule. Misaal: N₂O₅(g) → NO₂(g) + NO₃(g)
2. Bimolecular: do atoms, ions ya molecules. Misalein: CO(g) + NO₃(g) → NO₂(g) + CO₂(g); NO(g) + O₃(g) → NO₂(g) + O₂(g)
3. Termolecular: teen molecules ka aik saath reaction; aise steps kam hote hain. Misaal (stratosphere ya smog mein ozone): 2O₂(g) + O(g) → O₃(g) + O₂(g)

book_ref.quote: Many reactions do not occur in a single step, but rather proceed through a series of steps.

blocks.prompt:
20 Define intermediates and the rate-determining step. Explain, using the reaction 2NO(g) + 2H₂(g) → 2H₂O(g) + N₂(g), how the rate law and mechanism are related. (4 marks)
(Intermediates aur rate-determining step ki definitions dein. 2NO(g) + 2H₂(g) → 2H₂O(g) + N₂(g) ki madad se wazeh karein ke rate law aur mechanism ka kya taaluq hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Intermediates: kam umar wali species (ions ya free radicals) jo aik step mein bante aur agle step mein khatam hote hain; mustaqil products nahi, is liye overall equation mein nahi aate.

Rate-determining step: woh step jo baaqi sab se kaafi aahista ho. Yeh poore reaction ki raftaar mehdood kar ke overall rate control karta hai. Is ke reactants rate equation mein aate hain; is ke baad hissa lene wali species nahi aateen. Order isi se maloom hota hai.

Misaal: 2NO(g) + 2H₂(g) → 2H₂O(g) + N₂(g)
Tajurba (Table 7.3): [NO] sabit, [H₂] do ya teen guna to rate do ya teen guna, yani Rate ∝ [H₂]. [H₂] sabit, [NO] do guna to rate chaar guna, teen guna to nau guna, yani Rate ∝ [NO]².
Rate = k[H₂][NO]², third order; rate law balanced equation se nahi bataya ja sakta.

Mechanism:
Step 1 (aahista, rate-determining): 2NO(g) + H₂(g) → N₂(g) + H₂O₂(g)
Step 2 (tez): H₂O₂(g) + H₂(g) → 2H₂O(g)
Step 1 mein 2NO aur aik H₂ hain, jo Rate = k[NO]²[H₂] se milta hai. H₂O₂ intermediate hai aur dono steps jama ho kar overall equation banate hain.

book_ref.quote: In many reaction mechanisms, one step is significantly slower than all the others, this step is called the rate-determining step.

blocks.prompt:
21 Explain the mechanism of the reaction between nitrogen dioxide and fluorine and show that it agrees with the observed rate law. (4 marks)
(Nitrogen dioxide aur fluorine ke reaction ka mechanism wazeh karein aur dikhayein ke yeh observed rate law se mutabiqat rakhta hai.)
blocks.explanation:
Overall reaction: 2NO₂(g) + F₂(g) → 2NO₂F(g)

Observed rate law: Rate = k[NO₂][F₂]; NO₂ mein first, F₂ mein first, overall second order (coefficients ke mutabiq third nahi).

Mechanism:
Step 1 (aahista): NO₂(g) + F₂ → NO₂F(g) + F•(g); Rate = k₁[NO₂][F₂]
Step 2 (tez): NO₂(g) + F•(g) → NO₂F(g); Rate = k₂[NO₂][F•]

Mutabiqat: step 1 aahista aur rate-determining hai; is ka rate expression k₁[NO₂][F₂] observed rate law se milta hai. Tez doosra step rate par asar nahi daalta kyunke fluorine atoms bante hi NO₂ se react kar lete hain. F atom intermediate hai aur dono steps jama ho kar overall equation banate hain.

22 For 2NO(g) + 2H₂(g) → 2H₂O(g) + N₂(g), Rate = k[H₂][NO]². In one experiment ([NO] = 0.006 mol dm⁻³, [H₂] = 0.001 mol dm⁻³) the initial rate is 0.025 atm min⁻¹. Calculate the initial rate when (i) [H₂] = 0.003 mol dm⁻³ at the same [NO] (ii) [NO] = 0.012 mol dm⁻³ and [H₂] = 0.002 mol dm⁻³. (4 marks)
(2NO(g) + 2H₂(g) → 2H₂O(g) + N₂(g) ke liye Rate = k[H₂][NO]². Aik tajurbe mein ([NO] = 0.006, [H₂] = 0.001 mol dm⁻³) initial rate 0.025 atm min⁻¹ hai. Initial rate nikalein jab (i) usi [NO] par [H₂] = 0.003 mol dm⁻³ (ii) [NO] = 0.012 aur [H₂] = 0.002 mol dm⁻³.)
blocks.explanation: Rate ka factor = ([H₂] ka factor)¹ × ([NO] ka factor)²; maloom rate ko is se zarb dein.

book_ref.quote: In the next three experiments, the concentration of H₂ is kept constant.
